``` {r bootstrap}

# lmeresampler package

boot_m_n <- lmeresampler::bootstrap(m_n, .f = fixef, type = "wild", 
              hccme =  "hc2", aux.dist = "mammen", 
              B = 1000, resample = c(TRUE, TRUE))

boot_m_p <- lmeresampler::bootstrap(m_p, .f = fixef, type = "wild", 
              hccme =  "hc2", aux.dist = "mammen", 
              B = 1000, resample = c(TRUE, TRUE))

boot_m_d <- lmeresampler::bootstrap(m_d, .f = fixef, type = "wild",
```

``` {r boot table}

# lmersampler package

boot_list <- list(
  "Pozitív" = boot_m_p,
  "Negatív" = boot_m_n,
  "Dezorganizált" = boot_m_d,
  "Negatív - Pozitív" = boot_m_np,
  "Pozitív - Dezorganizált" = boot_m_pd,
  "Negatív - Dezorganizált" = boot_m_nd,
  "Pozitív - Negatív - Dezorganizált" = boot_m_all)

boot_table_f <- function(boot_table) {
  median <- apply(boot_table$replicates, 2, median) 
  se <- apply(boot_table$replicates, 2, sd) 
  ci <- confint(boot_table, type = "perc")
  p_vals <- apply(boot_table$replicates, 2, function(x) { 
    2 * min(mean(x <= 0, na.rm = TRUE), mean(x >= 0, na.rm = TRUE))
  })
  results <- data.frame(
    term          = ci$term,
    orig_estimate = ci$estimate,
    boot_median   = median,
    boot_se       = se,
    boot_ci_lower = ci$lower,
    boot_ci_upper = ci$upper,
    boot_p_value  = p_vals,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
  return(results)
}

boot_lmer_table <- map_df(boot_list, boot_table_f, .id = "model") %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  mutate(term = factor(term,
                      levels = c("sch_neg", "sch_pos", "sch_dis"),
                      labels = c("Negatív", "Pozitív", "Dezorganizált")))

saveRDS(boot_lmer_table, "boot_models/boot_lmer_table")

```

``` {r boot vis}

boot_lmer_table$term <- factor(boot_lmer_table$term, 
                               levels = c("Pozitív", "Negatív", "Dezorganizált"))
boot_lmer_table$model <- factor(boot_lmer_table$model, 
                                levels = c("Pozitív - Negatív - Dezorganizált",
                                           "Negatív - Dezorganizált",
                                           "Pozitív - Dezorganizált",
                                           "Negatív - Pozitív",
                                           "Dezorganizált",
                                           "Negatív",
                                           "Pozitív"))

boot_lmer_table <- boot_lmer_table %>%
  mutate(p_sign = case_when(
    boot_p_value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0,05",
    boot_p_value > 0.05 ~ "p > 0,05"))


colors <- c("Pozitív" = "#FC8D62FF",
            "Negatív" = "#80B1D3", 
            "Dezorganizált" = "#BC80BD")
shapes <- c("p < 0,05"= 16,
           "p > 0,05" = 1)

boot_worried <- 
  ggplot(boot_lmer_table, aes(x = (boot_ci_lower + boot_ci_upper) / 2, y = model, xmin = boot_ci_lower, xmax = boot_ci_upper)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkgrey", linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(color = term, shape = p_sign, group = term), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.3), 
    linewidth = 0.8, size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Dimenzió",
                     labels = c("Pozitív", "Negatív", "Dezorganizált"),
                     values = colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Szignifikancia",
                     labels = c("p < 0,05", "p > 0,05"),
                     values = shapes) +
  labs(title = "Aggodalom - multilevel modellek bootstrappelt becslései",
       x = "Bootstrappelt becslések (95% CI)", 
       y = NULL) + 
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank())

print(boot_worried)

ggsave("plots/boot_worried.png", plot = boot_worried, height = 12, width = 20, units = "cm", dpi = 300)
```
